verdict.rationale: Otter's own integrations run actions automatically on meeting events: it sends transcripts and summaries to Airtable, turns meeting takeaways into Zendesk/ServiceNow tickets, and auto-joins scheduled meetings. Triggering actions from meeting content is otherwise described only through the Enterprise Public API, and Webhooks and Zapier are listed only as pricing-page items, which makes them developer building blocks rather than a rule builder. missing for 10: a documented user-facing rule or trigger definition with conditions, configurable event types, a description of how webhooks are registered, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Otter automatically sends transcripts, summaries, and meeting metadata to Airtable.
Automatically turn meeting takeaways into support tickets or updates in tools like Zendesk and ServiceNow.
Teams can automatically ingest meeting transcripts into internal knowledge bases or trigger actions based on meeting content
